name: Siargao Island
description: The surfing capital of the Philippines, famous for Cloud 9's barreling waves, palm-fringed lagoons, hidden beaches, and a laid-back island vibe that draws travelers from around the world.

name: Dinagat Islands
description: A remote archipelago of pristine turquoise coves, dramatic limestone cliffs, and quiet white-sand beaches — a true off-the-beaten-path paradise in northern Caraga.

name: Agusan Marsh
description: One of the Philippines' largest wetland sanctuaries — a vast network of rivers, lakes, and floating villages teeming with birdlife, perfect for tranquil river safaris and cultural encounters.

name: Higatangan Island
description: A long sandbar fringed by clear blue waters and palm trees, surrounded by vibrant coral gardens — ideal for swimming, snorkeling, and quiet beach days.

name: Tinuy-an Falls
description: Often called the 'Little Niagara of the Philippines,' this spectacular multi-tiered curtain waterfall cascades through lush jungle — one of the widest falls in the country.

name: Butuan City
description: A historic river city and gateway to Caraga, known for ancient balangay boats, museum heritage, and relaxing cruises along the Agusan River — where culture meets nature.
